description: Publish an HTML page on HTMLpad and get a public link to share. Returns the link, a private edit link and an edit token. Free pads stay online for 90 days. Pages may not contain password or payment card fields.

address.description: Optional address for the page, as in htmlpad.org/<address>/. Letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores, up to 64.

html.description: A complete HTML document or fragment, up to 512 KB.

name: publish_html
title: Publish HTML
